findings: Narrative text reports susceptibility to tetracycline, whereas the displayed table reports minocycline rather than tetracycline; this was preserved as a source-level terminology inconsistency rather than reconciled.

schema_gaps: The current atom schema has no dedicated case-report atom kind.

QuantitativeResult supports one scalar estimate and cannot faithfully encode a full five-column MIC vector with inequality-qualified values such as >128 or <0.06. Each antimicrobial table row was therefore preserved as an atom_kind=other canonical statement with row-level table provenance.
extraction_limitations: The PDF contains portions of adjacent letters on pages 1 and 3; only the target article spanning journal pages 2049-2051 was extracted.
No funding, conflict-of-interest, or data-availability statement was present for the target letter in the retrieved pages.
Clinical treatment response is observational in a single patient and does not establish azithromycin-specific efficacy because latamoxef was administered concurrently.
